verdict.rationale: Bolna publishes an open-source, production-ready voice-agent framework on GitHub (bolna-gh-1). Its docs describe self-hosting on your own servers with Docker or Kubernetes (bolna-docs-9), which together cover the core of the story. The self-hosting guide sits under an 'enterprise' section, so it is unclear whether it deploys the open-source code or a licensed build. Missing for 10: confirmation that the on-premise deployment runs from the open-source repo rather than an enterprise offering, detailed self-hosting steps and component coverage (telephony, dashboard), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment.
